header.name: Design Research Methodology (DRM)
header.description: This advanced project-based course reframes Design as both a creative practice and a facilitative process. Students will enagege in discussions on Design and learn to mobilize multiple scientific perspectives, combine Design Research Methodology (DRM), Research (for/into/through) Design in idiosyncratic ways, tackling complex design problems. This course utimately aims to broaden the discussions on Design discipline and introduces various facets of Design Research beyond traditional apporaches of design methods, processes and user-centerd design.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Understand key concepts, theoretical underpinnings, and historical milestones of Design Research

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Apply Design Research approaches to tackle complex design problems.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Synthesize multiple scientific perspectives to broaden design discourse beyond traditional methods and theorize new design paradigms.

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Develop and present an original design framework that contributes novel insights to the field of Design Research, demonstrating rigorous validation and reflective practice.

lecture_topics: Reflections on Design: What is Design?
Reflections on Design Research: Historical trajectories, shifts, and debates
Terminologies - Design Research, Design Science Research, Design Reserach Methodologies
Understanding Research for, into, through Design
Research Design & Planning: Formulating research questions and hypotheses
Quantitative Methods: Experiments, Statistics, Hypotheses Testing
Mixed Methods in Design Research: Triangulation, validity, reliability, research rigor
Communicating Design Research: Academic writing, visual argumentation, reflective narration, Portfolios
Intellectual Property in Design Research: Patents, copyrights, licensing, technology transfer
Consolidation Workshop: Integrating Quantitative & Qualitative Methods
